stage: DDR budget for the fully quantised 28-layer W8A8 deployment
supersedes: the earlier FP32-based plan; W8A8 is the deployment form because FP32 does not fit (validation/board/fp32-28layer-does-not-fit.json)

high.holds: .workspace (NOLOAD): parameters, KV cache, W8A8 workspace, tokenizer

tokenizer.note: 5.2 MB packed BPE resource; the Unicode tables the encoder needs are 49,656 B and live in .rodata

workspace_breakdown.lowering_runtime_buffers: about 13 MiB allocated by the graph itself per prefill call, served by the NR bump allocator

verification.note: the linker reports the .workspace size directly; it must fit in the 1152 MiB HIGH region and end below 4 GiB

address_check.note: the parameters are placed first in .workspace, so the segment's load address and the arena's address are both 0xb8000000; a later region would not have this property

measured_one_layer.what: prefill (16 tokens) + 8 decode steps, fully quantised W8A8, on FPGA5

derivation_for_28_layers.assumption: a decode step costs one unit and the 16-token prefill costs about sixteen, which is what a per-token cost model gives
derivation_for_28_layers.arithmetic: 16u + 8u = 24u = 5.516e9 cycles -> u = 2.30e8 cycles; the one-layer prefill is therefore about 3.7e9 cycles (250 s)
derivation_for_28_layers.projection: 28 x 250 s = about 7000 s, i.e. roughly 117 minutes
derivation_for_28_layers.window: the run in flight was launched with a 9000 s capture window, so it has about 30 minutes of margin if the cost is linear in layers
derivation_for_28_layers.caveat: this is a projection from one measurement, not a measured multi-layer cost; a per-layer board measurement would settle it and needs a short window rather than a long one

runtime_projection.correction_to_an_earlier_estimate: an earlier note put the attention alone at about 51 minutes for 28 layers, computed from the Stage A attention kernel cycles. That was wrong: attention is not in the replacement set, so the graph lowers it as linalg and never calls those kernels.

review_2026_09_17.status: SUPERSEDED estimate; actual both-entry full-replacement linked HIGH persistent storage is 1010.32 MiB before tokenizer
review_2026_09_17.note: LOW static and scoped graph heap are separate; older 737.99 MiB omitted current attention workspaces and live temporaries
